mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair glucose metabolism and increase hypoglycemia risk; additionally, renal dysfunction reduces glipizide clearance leading to accumulation.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, consider alternative antifungal if possible, assess renal function regularly, monitor electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and adjust glipizide dose based on renal function and glycemic response.
